cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('crates/wasmi/src/store/inner.rs')
s = p.read_text()
# Add methods before try_resolve_data_mut or near other resolve helpers. Insert after try_resolve_instance.
anchor = '''    /// Returns a shared reference to the [`ExternRefEntity`] associated to the given [`ExternRef`].'''
methods = '''    /// Returns the stable arena index of the given [`Memory`].
    ///
    /// # Panics
    ///
    /// If `memory` does not originate from this [`StoreInner`].
    pub(crate) fn resolve_memory_index(&self, memory: &Memory) -> usize {
        let raw = self
            .unwrap_stored(memory.as_raw())
            .expect("memory must originate from this store");
        raw.into_usize()
    }

    /// Returns the stable arena index of the given [`Global`].
    ///
    /// # Panics
    ///
    /// If `global` does not originate from this [`StoreInner`].
    pub(crate) fn resolve_global_index(&self, global: &Global) -> usize {
        let raw = self
            .unwrap_stored(global.as_raw())
            .expect("global must originate from this store");
        raw.into_usize()
    }

'''
idx = s.find(anchor)
assert idx != -1
s = s[:idx] + methods + s[idx:]
p.write_text(s)
print("done")
